reason: Neither direction holds, and the two reasons are different. Outbound, DV_PROPORTION carries bare decimals and no units, so no DV_PROPORTION produces a Ratio whose numerator and denominator carry a system and a code — the fhir:ratio.units row says so. Inbound, DV_PROPORTION.type is mandatory and no Ratio carries a kind discriminator, so ratioToDvProportion produces nothing at all.
